title: Canary fallback operator runbook and tokenstore snapshot verifier
creator: Ava Patel
description: Produce an operator-facing runbook and an automated verifier for tokenstore snapshots that supports a canary fallback exercise. The goal is to validate end-to-end fallback behavior (hosted -> passive region), ensure tokenstore point-in-time snapshot integrity, and exercise circuit-breaker-driven traffic tapering without impacting customer-facing SLOs.
background: Previous DR rehearsals exposed ambiguous operator steps during manual fallback, and tokenstore recovery validation has been manual and flaky. We need a concise operator runbook paired with an automated snapshot verifier that can be run in a sandbox and during scheduled drills. This will reduce human error and shorten mean time to recovery during passive promotions.
goals: Ship a one-page operator runbook for canary fallback with clear decision gates
Deliver a tokenstore snapshot verifier that checks atomicity, sequence continuity, and migration readiness
Validate circuit-breaker thresholds and traffic taper policy that preserves latency SLOs during staged fallback
Run a scheduled non-production drill and gather SLO telemetry to baseline impact
non_goals: Automating full cross-region failover (this work focuses on canary/fallback, not full automation)
Covering on-prem Private deployments in this initial scope
success_criteria: Operator runbook reviewed and approved by SRE and oncall leads
Snapshot verifier returns deterministic pass/fail across 10 recent snapshots
Canary fallback performed in sandbox with <5% increase in 99th latency and no token loss
Post-drill checklist completed and two follow-up action items created
acceptance_criteria: Runbook contains step-by-step checks, CLI commands, expected outputs, and rollbacks
Verifier script has unit tests and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs on PRs to tokenstore
Drill run produces a telemetry report (latency, error-rate, throughput) attached to the ticket
All operator-facing warnings are surfaced in Console Alerts during exercise
plan_steps: Draft runbook v0 with decision gates and safe-rollback points (owner: Liam)
Implement tokenstore-snapshot-verifier (python) to validate sequence numbers, TTLs, and key parity (owner: SRE infra)
Add circuit-breaker canary policy in staging route table: 25% traffic -> 50% -> 100% fallback with 5m hold windows
Schedule a sandbox drill (non-prod) and invite oncall, SRE, and PM observers
Run drills, collect telemetry, and iterate on thresholds
Review and onboard runbook into ops-runbooks repo and link from Console
testing_plan: Unit tests for verifier covering corrupted snapshot, incomplete manifest, and drift scenarios
Integration test: restore verifier output -> simulated tokenstore mount -> kv-consistency-check
Load test during canary: synthetic traffic generator targeting latency-sensitive endpoints at production percentiles
Chaos injection: transient circuit-breaker trips to validate graceful taper and automatic fallback

2026-02-20: Draft runbook v0 uploaded to Confluence; requested review from oncall leads (Liam)
2026-02-28: Verifier prototype completed; able to assert sequence continuity on local snapshots (SRE infra)
2026-03-05: Circuit-breaker canary policy staged in staging cluster; initial 25% taper observed without SLO regression
2026-03-12: Scheduled sandbox drill for 2026-03-15; telemetry collection pipeline validated
risks: Verifier false positives on snapshots with in-flight writes -> could block drills
Operator confusion if runbook language is ambiguous under stress
Unexpected side-effects of circuit-breaker policies in shared staging clusters
mitigation: Add a permissive 'warning' mode to verifier for drills that logs instead of failing
Run tabletop walkthroughs with oncall before live drill
Limit staging canary to a sandbox tenant and cap throughput during initial test
postmortem_followup: Document any tokenstore drift incidents and add automated alerts to Console
If verifier warnings exceed threshold in two consecutive runs, create follow-up for deterministic fixes
Add one-liner recovery commands to runbook based on drill learnings
operator_instructions: Step 0: Confirm you are in the sandbox project and have the right IAM role
Step 2: Validate verifier output: expect 'sequence-contiguous: true' and 'orphan-keys: 0'
Step 3: Trigger canary fallback via console: Route -> Policies -> Apply canary-fallback-2026-03
Step 4: Monitor SLO dashboard (ops/latency/slo-99) and circuit-breaker logs for 15 minutes
Step 5: If recovery path needed, follow rollback_plan commands below
kpi_slo_targets: Token loss: 0 confirmed after verifier run
rollback_plan: If canary causes >1% sustained error-rate or tokenstore verifier detects missing sequence ranges, immediately abort fallback in Console (Route -> Policies -> Revert), reattach traffic to primary, and run tokenstore restore from last known-good snapshot. Notify oncall and open a triage ticket. Restore steps are documented in the confluence link above.
